fields.title: 040's common scalar account retains model and installed-qualification gaps.
fields.finding: 040 recomputes the 037b construction with its own loads, coating, pad and service bill. R10 does not float; R30 ranks least optimism among tested radii. Coating+primer at an assumed .20 kg/m2 and retained water are the largest assumed debits. Keep this account distinct from old 028b/033/037/034 variants and the 044 life spectrum. The original +0.120151 kg is a fixed-geometry allowance; 040 recomputes joining. Neither mass closure nor scalar SF closes installed qualification.
